entities.name: UE-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to transport NAS messages between the UE and network.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message sent by the UE to the network.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message sent by the network to the UE.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Information element containing the transported NAS message or other payload.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload being transported.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

relations.description: UE-initiated NAS transport procedure includes sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message.
UE-initiated NAS transport procedure may include receiving DL NAS TRANSPORT message.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains payload container IE.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains payload container type IE.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains payload container IE.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains payload container type IE.
UE-initiated NAS transport procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
